actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU so it exposes a telnet-accessible console on 127.0.0.1:6665, leave it running in the background, and block until the login prompt is ready for telnet login.
required_artifacts: A local telnet-accessible console bound to 127.0.0.1:6665
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully in the background
Connecting with telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches the guest login prompt
The process remains running after readiness is confirmed
known_invalid_patterns: Treating file existence or command non-error output as success
Stopping after launch without confirming telnet readiness
Using a different port or inaccessible console endpoint
verification_plan: Launch QEMU with a serial console exposed over telnet on 127.0.0.1:6665
Probe the port until the login prompt is observed
Record receipts for launch and readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing QEMU launched with the correct telnet console mapping
Receipt showing 127.0.0.1:6665 is reachable and presents the login prompt
